Independently review the designated IDs below using only the literal questions and options. All 30 masked questions are supplied for cross-item dependence assessment, but solve ONLY the 10 designated IDs. No tools, author keys, family labels, earlier outputs, or author context are supplied. Derive each answer before evaluating options. Check unique support, ambiguity, assumptions, plausibility of distractors, answer cues, and template dependence. Return ONLY compact JSON with items and overall_execution_blockers (list). Every item must have item_id, chosen_letter (A/B/null), derived_answer, derivation (maximum 35 words), unique_supported_answer (boolean), alternative_assessment (maximum 20 words), concerns (maximum 20 words), expected_difficulty (easy/medium/hard), template_overlap (maximum 20 words), disposition (retain/repair/exclude/unresolved), must_fix_before_execution (boolean). Use 1-2 short sentences per derivation. Flag weak or repetitive items, and distinguish a development limitation from a blocker to executing a descriptive calibration. Do not force a key for ambiguous questions.
Designated IDs: ["F001", "F002", "F003", "F004", "F005", "F006", "F007", "F008", "F009", "F010"]
